text:
amy_sales: POC with KineHealth — streaming calls keep dropping when client is behind their corporate proxy. Demo scheduled TOMORROW morning, they see 'socket hang up' or 502 during long generation (>30s). Can eng help triage? :grimacing:
ben_sre: @amy_sales can you paste a sample client config + any gateway logs? Is this only TS client or Python too?
carlos_eng: saw similar before — often proxy is closing the idle upstream connection while the stream is open. Need keepAlive + proper timeouts on the proxy agent.
ajulia_se: they sent an excerpt from their dev machine logs: "Error: socket hang up at TLSSocket.onHangUp (node:internal/stream_base_commons:...)" and our server logs show "upstream reset (ECONNRESET)" at ~32s.
amy_sales: pasted their minimal reproduction (TS):
```
import fetch from 'node-fetch';
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  body: JSON.stringify({model: 'rw-13b', prompt: '...'}),
  headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer XXX'},
  timeout: 60000,
});
```
ben_sre: okay two quick asks: are they using a corporate proxy (HTTP CONNECT) with a gateway that has a short idle timeout? and are they using the Node HTTPS agent defaults?
carlos_eng: recommend switching to an explicit proxy agent with keepAlive and a longer free socket timeout. Example for node-fetch/https-proxy-agent:
```
import HttpsProxyAgent from 'https-proxy-agent';
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent({ keepAlive: true, timeout: 120000 });
await fetch(url, { agent, ... });
```
Also increase curl/SDK timeouts client-side.
ajulia_se: also flag for SDK: enable chunked streaming backpressure rather than buffering whole response. We have a known issue where some proxies mis-handle long-lived chunked streams and force-close.
amy_sales: the customer says their infra team can't change proxy TTLs. Any server-side mitigations?
carlos_eng: we can implement reconnectable streaming wrapper in the SDK — resume on the last token using prefix caching — but that's a product change, not quick. Short-term: suggest switching to our polling endpoint (non-stream) for the demo or use smaller max_tokens so each stream finishes <25s.
ben_sre: on our side I can add a graceful retry policy in the gateway: if upstream connection terminates mid-stream, return 502 with x-redwood-err: upstream-stream-reset, and our client can retry idempotently when request is resumable. But that requires client changes.
amy_sales: customer asked about pricing impact if we recommend polling vs streaming (they're cost-sensitive). Julia, any notes?
ajulia_se: polling will slightly increase tokens spent on repeated prompts if you do retries, but for short demo it's negligible. For production, batching + caching recommendations from Optimize can reduce cost.
amy_sales: they also have an E2E security checklist — are there any blockers for proxy inspection (TLS intercept)?
carlos_eng: if their proxy performs TLS MITM, we need to ensure cert pinning isn't enforced on their side. Our hosted endpoints support mutual-TLS optional for enterprise, but for POC recommend standard TLS with HTTPS_PROXY env var.
ben_sre: quick triage plan: 1) Ask customer to try node agent keepAlive example and raise client timeout to 120s. 2) If still failing, switch to non-streaming endpoint for demo. 3) I'll enable debug logging on gateway (trace IDs) — send us a failing request timestamp.
amy_sales: I sent them the keepAlive snippet and asked for a failing request example + timestamp. They replied with a sample request ts 2026-03-20T18:07:12Z and a chunk of gateway log: "proxy_conn closed after 32014ms, upstream_reset ECONNRESET"
carlos_eng: good — we can correlate to trace id. @deploy-bot can you confirm if there were any deployments around that time?
deploy-bot: deployment: services/gateway v1.42.0 rolled at 2026-03-20T17:50:03Z by ci-pipeline (no config changes to proxy timeouts).
enam_sre: (typo intended) — disregarded
ben_sre: thanks. If customer still blocked after keepAlive change, recommend demo on polling and we'll schedule a follow-up to ship SDK resilience changes.
amy_sales: customer is okay with polling for demo. I'll update the opportunity: they also asked for a short note on recommended client settings — I'll add the snippet + suggested timeouts + a one-liner on proxy edge cases.
ajulia_se: added a short FAQ blurb we can hand them: "If you're behind a corporate proxy that forcibly closes idle connections, enable keepAlive on the proxy agent or use the non-streaming endpoint. For production, contact SE for an SDK patch to enable resumable streaming."
amy_sales: awesome, thanks team. Marking this as triaged — demo using polling tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
